page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.t5-c1m4.large is a burstable instance type belonging to the ecs.t5 family. It features 2 vCPUs mapped to 1 physical Intel Xeon 8163 core with 2 threads per core, operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 8.0 GB of RAM, providing 4.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and has a baseline network bandwidth of 0 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks place this instance in the lower tiers. The stress-ng single-core CPU score is 1057.79, categorized as weak, while the multi-core score of 2090.03 is categorized as poor. Similarly, Geekbench scores are low, with a single-core score of 870.0 and a multi-core score of 1493.0. Memory bandwidth tests show poor performance, with read-only large block bandwidth at 16.3 GB/sec and write large block bandwidth at 14.44 GB/sec.

This instance is designed for budget-conscious workloads that experience sporadic CPU utilization. The burstable CPU allocation model allows the instance to handle occasional spikes in demand, though sustained high-compute tasks will be throttled. It is suited for lightweight applications such as low-traffic static web serving, basic Redis caching, and simple development or testing environments.
